provider.name: Fintraffic Digitraffic (road weather cameras)
provider.description: Fintraffic, the Finnish state traffic management company, publishes its national road weather camera network — over 470 stations — through the open Digitraffic API. Each station carries several numbered presets covering different directions of view, and images are served from a public host with no key required. The licence is the cleanest in this registry: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, which explicitly permits redistribution and commercial use.
provider.attribution: Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY
provider.rateLimitNotes: Digitraffic asks that clients use compression and conditional requests and avoid unnecessary polling. Station images update on a roughly 10-minute collection interval, so metadata refresh should be no more frequent than that.
